prompt: Trong mặt phẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math>, cho hai điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>17</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>11</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>. Xác định tọa độ trung điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mi>M</mi></semantics></math> của đoạn thẳng <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mi>C</mi></mrow></semantics></math>.
solution:
Với điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>17</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và điểm <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>11</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>, ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>;</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mn>17</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>14</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>.
		Vậy <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>M</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>14</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math>.
